title: Llama Llama Shopping Drama
author: Anna Dewdney

hero.name: Llama Llama
hero.description: Young llama character in red pyjamas, distinctive Anna Dewdney character
hero.source_note: Named character — source from Creative Fabrica or TPT clip art; look for Anna Dewdney Llama Llama series art

ambiguous.issue: Could mean a written shopping list (noun) or to list/tilt (verb)
ambiguous.reason: Book involves Mama consulting a shopping list at the grocery store; noun meaning is correct

ambiguous.issue: Could be confused with the name 'bye' or the word 'by'
ambiguous.reason: Book is about purchasing items at a store; search for purchase or buy icon showing money exchange

notes: The core theme of this book is waiting and patience — Llama Llama gets bored and upset while Mama shops. Key fringe words reflect the shopping setting (store, cart, list, buy), the emotional journey (bored, cry), and the relational resolution (mama, wait, busy, together). 'Bored' and 'wait' are high-value communication targets for AAC users who may experience similar feelings. 'Together' captures the resolution and is a useful social word. The hero image must clearly be the Llama Llama series character, not a generic llama, as students will recognise the specific art style.
